approval.approval_reason: Move obligation-to-subparagraph policy targets out of executable code into an auditable approved intelligence artifact.

scope.constraint: Subparagraph resolution is additive and must not weaken section-level citation validation.

targets.rationale: Scope obligation is section-level and has no narrower paragraph marker in the cited section chunk.
Traceability plan establishment and maintenance requirement begins at paragraph (a).
Traceability lot code assignment triggers are listed in paragraph (a).
The approved obligation covers both harvesting records in paragraph (a) and cooling-before-initial-packing records in paragraph (b).
The core initial packing KDE maintenance requirement is in paragraph (a).
The cited first land-based receiving section has no narrower paragraph marker in the canonical chunk.
Shipping records are maintained under paragraph (a) and provided to the immediate subsequent recipient under paragraph (b).
The ordinary receiving record requirement is in paragraph (a); paragraphs (b) and (c) are exceptions/special cases.
The ordinary transformation record requirement is in paragraph (a); paragraphs (b) and (c) are exceptions/special cases.
Record form, electronic links, legibility, and storage requirements are in paragraphs (a)(1) and (a)(2).
The general 24-hour FDA availability obligation is in paragraph (c)(1).
The electronic sortable spreadsheet requirement is specifically in paragraph (c)(3)(ii), not paragraph (b)(3).
